panels.visual: The Odeon of Herodes Atticus: arched stone facade and curved rows, a summer-night concert with musicians and lanterns
panels.caption: A music hall for about five thousand people, built around AD 161.

panels.visual: Herodes Atticus (rich Greek in fine robes, beard) standing in front of his building proudly, a coin purse
panels.caption: Herodes Atticus was the richest man in Greece.

panels.visual: Herodes by a grave wreath with a sad face, the half-built Odeon behind him, dusk
panels.caption: He built it in memory of his wife Regilla. She died while pregnant.

panels.visual: A Roman court with magistrates and Herodes standing calmly while Regilla's brother points at him accusingly
panels.caption: Her brother accused him of ordering it. He was tried in Rome and let off.
